question: Who among the following was honoured with the Padma Shri in 2011 for his/her excellence in Chhau, a semi-classical dance form of Eastern India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Makar Dhwaja Daroga.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Makar Dhwaja Darogha **was an Indian old style artist and master, known for his aptitude in the traditional dance type of Chhau.
 
• Darogha was granted** Padma Shri in 2011** for his remarkable commitment to the advancement of the Seraikela type of Chhau dance.
 
• The Government of India respected him in 2011, with the fourth most noteworthy non military personnel grant **of Padma Shri.**
 
• His child Deepak said: "My dad used to prepare devotees across Kolhan district, especially **in West Singhbhum and Seraikela-Kharswan.**
